holm_family_note: Step-down Holm-Bonferroni is applied across each lens family pooled over ALL Half-2-tested candidates (tested_candidates + cocycle_probes + intermod_probes, unfiltered by Half-2 significance) across all 7 analyzed phases (13 lens families, 421 total Half-2-tested hypotheses). At N_confirm=799 (empirical floor p_min=1/800=0.00125), any lens family with m>=4 has minimum possible Holm p >= 4/800 = 0.005 and cannot clear p_Holm < 0.005. Under the full tested candidate universe, 0 rows survive pooled p_Holm < 0.005 (smallest pooled min_p_holm=0.010000) and 421 Half-2-tested candidates are recorded in holm_rejected. For transparency, per_phase_lens_holm_diagnostic also reports per-(phase, lens) Holm counts over the same unfiltered tested candidates (28 across all lenses; 24 excluding A4 RTS/burst rows).
phase_e_reentry_caveat: PREREG-S113-AMENDMENT1 specified that surviving blind anomalies should immediately trigger targeted Phase-E confirmatory probes before the 2026-11-25T14:44:00Z sensor shutoff. In practice, per-phase blind-hunter execution finished after shutoff (14:50:09Z-15:17:54Z), and Phases E1/E2 targeted H1/H3/H4 physics probes rather than blind-hunter triggers; the Phase-E re-entry rule was therefore not executed from blind-hunter survivors.
sigma_framing_note: All z (sigma) values in this receipt are parametric extrapolations (obs - mean_surr) / sd_surr from the surrogate sample, NOT empirical tail probabilities; at N_confirm=799 the empirical p-value floor is strictly 1/800 = 0.00125.
reproducibility_scope: Raw physical captures and binary telemetry arrays are NOT shipped in this repository (AV=0 privacy-preserving policy). Raw per-phase physical anomaly rows are therefore not independently reproducible from the repository alone; pooled lens-family Holm-Bonferroni recomputation, receipt cryptographic binding, and synthetic positive/null lens tests ARE independently reproducible.
